text: The book writes the mass-shell condition p_μ p^μ = −m²c². Which relation is the equivalent statement of this Lorentz invariant?
choices: E = mc² + ½mv² for every particle
E = mc² for every particle regardless of momentum
explanation: Expanding p_μp^μ = −(E/c)² + |p|² = −m²c² gives E² = (pc)² + (mc²)², the energy-momentum relation. Choice 0 (E = pc) holds only for massless particles (m = 0) and choice 3 (E = mc²) only at rest (p = 0); choice 2 is merely the low-speed approximation E ≈ mc² + ½mv². Here m is the invariant rest mass, the same in all frames.
